history: 68 years ago extradimensional debris introduced altered minerals and biological catalysts.
A minority could activate Cellular Matrix patterns.
Wars and collapse led to Continental Security Accords.
Mandatory two-year academy service begins at sixteen.
Abilities are licensed, tested, insured, and regulated.

abilities.origin: Cellular Matrix expression shaped by genetics, exposure, and training
abilities.meaning: safe output and throughput, not guaranteed combat strength

economy.academy_pay: 18 credits per training day plus stipends
